integrity: The equilibrium classification is proved by direct algebra from the source model and cross-checked against both symmetric numerical examples reported in the source. The global phase portrait in the strict three-equilibrium region uses Sontag's published Theorem 1.
scientific_limitations: Exchange-symmetric deterministic Hill-exponent-one family only; no asymmetric closed criterion, stochastic classification, or local normal-form theorem on the equality surface is claimed.
title: Exact bistability threshold in the exchange-symmetric two-gene competitive system
